header: The umbrella over everything the search bar answers from the intranet's own records (docs/QUERY_UMBRELLA_PLAN.md). Utility Services (src/tools/) and Executive Deep Synthesis stay outside it. A "scope" is a FIXED SELECTION the reader makes (People, PAX, Hospital OPD, Holidays, Degrees, Circulars) instead of leaving the bar to guess; "auto" is today's behaviour, untouched. I keep domain names out of this file: the list of them is domains.ts.

symbols.name: ScopeId
doc: The fixed selections; "auto" means the bar decides, exactly as before.

symbols.name: DomainId
doc: The records the bar can search (EDS, the executives' deep synthesis, is a choice of the bar but not a record: it has its own route)

symbols.name: PeopleFacet
doc: How a person is looked for, once People is selected.

members.name: hint
doc: A single short sentence shown under the selection.

members.name: examples
doc: Tap-to-fill lines that work under this facet (none for the finder: it has pick-lists)

members.name: label
doc: the chip's text

members.name: hint
doc: One sentence saying what the bar does when this is chosen.

members.name: placeholder
doc: The box's placeholder while this one is chosen.

members.name: examples
doc: Lines that work under this selection, shown as tap-to-fill examples; where an engine can be run offline, the selftest runs each one through the real engine.

members.name: cues
doc: Words that make a line this domain's own, for the hint "Looks like ..."

members.name: named
doc: The words that NAME the domain ("pax", "opd", "holiday", "circular"): a line holding one is explicit about what it wants

members.name: scopeLines
doc: The forms of the line I give this domain's engine, in the order to try them, until one answers: the line as typed when that is already the engine's own kind of line, then the line completed with the domain's cue word when the person left it out ("pax number of ...", "... opd", "what is ..."). Pure.

symbols.name: Claim
doc: One claim of the planner: this domain could answer, this strongly.

symbols.name: Plan
doc: The planner's reading of a line. I use it for hints and the shadow log only: nothing is routed by it unless the reader chose a scope.

members.name: best
doc: The best claim, or null when the line is only text for the documents / the model

members.name: ambiguous
doc: True when two domains are close enough that the bar should not guess.

symbols.name: Selection
doc: What the reader has chosen in the bar: the selection, for People the way of looking, and the finder's two lists and name.

members.name: dept
doc: The department id from the pick-list ("" means any).

members.name: grade
doc: The designation id from the pick-list ("" means any).

members.name: nm
doc: An optional part of a name for the finder.
